Comment DITTO and I’ll DM you the details.

#ad #partnership".

279 likes, 3 comments - ca.jaydesai on September 29, 2026: "Some of the biggest businesses we use every day aren’t based in India. 🌎

From the tech we use to the brands we interact with, the world of investing goes far beyond our borders.

For an Indian investor, that means diversification doesn’t necessarily have to stop at India.

With HDFC Sky, you can explore international markets and invest in global companies — bringing more of the world within reach. 

Because your investment opportunities don’t have to be limited by geography.

Investments are subject to market risks. Do your own research before investing.".

80 likes, 10 comments - ca.jaydesai on September 11, 2026: "A coffee meeting in 2016. A first angel cheque. And now, a potential 152x outcome.

@nitishmittersain ‘s investment in @rentomojo is a great example of what makes angel investing so different.

You’re often betting before the numbers look obvious, and the journey can get very messy before it works.

That’s also why early-stage investing is a portfolio game: a few exceptional winners can drive a large part of the returns.

At Insiders Club, we’re building a platform for serious investors to discover private-market opportunities, and for high-quality startups to access the right capital.

If you’re an investor or a founder, comment below “Insiders” and we’ll share more details. Cheers!".

1,058 likes, 1 comments - ca.jaydesai on August 26, 2026: "Most business owners obsess over sales.

But very few pay enough attention to what happens after the customer clicks “Pay.”

Your payment gateway affects:
✅ how fast you can start accepting payments
✅ how quickly settlements reach your bank
✅ what happens when something goes wrong
✅ and how much every transaction costs you

That’s why I’m starting Business Essentials — a series on the boring-but-critical things every business owner should understand.

Part 1: How to choose a payment gateway.

I recently evaluated Cashfree on these exact parameters — and with quick onboarding, next-day settlements, dedicated support, and their current 0% MDR offer for eligible new merchants, it’s a pretty compelling option to consider.

Check out the offer through the link in bio.".

243 likes, 10 comments - ca.jaydesai on August 8, 2026: "Most people are chasing the next AI app.

But some of the biggest opportunities are hiding in businesses that solve very real human problems.

India’s elderly population is growing rapidly. Their children are often in different cities—or even different countries. And that gap is creating demand for an entirely new category of business: eldercare concierge.

Not glamorous.
Not viral.
But potentially a massive business over the next decade.

This is Part 1 of my series on invisible businesses that could create the next generation of entrepreneurs.

Would your family pay for a trusted eldercare concierge service?

👇 Let me know in the comments.

#Business #Startup #Entrepreneurship #India #BusinessIdeas Healthcare Eldercare BusinessModel FutureOfWork WealthCreation".
